grading: symmetric token F1 between the returned answer and the recorded answer, computed by run_ablation_framef.graded_correct; for multiple choice the marked option index must match. Grading was performed against the sealed records and only the resulting decisions are published.
thresholds_source: read from this run's own ABLATION_REPORT.json, not chosen by the release builder: the pre-registration forbids re-analysing a sealed ablation, so a run is graded only at the thresholds its report tabulates
why: the pre-registered ablation; the census generator answered its own items, so this endpoint cannot be separated from self-consistency
